history.summary: FLAG: TEMPLE IDENTITY UNCONFIRMED. Indira Gandhi Park is a public park near VIP Road / Sector D in Itanagar (geocoded at 27.0962, 93.62185) - every source consulted describes it only as a lush green recreational park, and no source mentions any temple or shrine inside or adjoining it. No 'Indira Gandhi Park Temple' could be verified on the web. The CSV row appears to conflate a tourist attraction (the park) with a temple; it may also be a mis-labelling of some other Itanagar shrine. Deities, festivals and tradition are therefore left blank. Recommend correction or removal of this row unless a specific shrine is identified. Media is intentionally empty: park-only photos exist but would mislabel the entry.

name: Indira Gandhi Park Temple
town_description: Itanagar, the capital of Arunachal Pradesh in the Papum Pare district, sits in the Himalayan foothills and is named after the historic Ita Fort ('fort of bricks'). Key attractions include the Ita Fort, the Jawaharlal Nehru State Museum, Ganga Lake (Gekar Sinyi), Indira Gandhi Park and the hilltop Buddhist Gompa.

travel.airport: Lilabari Airport (Assam) is the commonly cited nearest airport in travel guides; the newer Donyi Polo Airport (Holongi) now serves the Itanagar region (verify distance).
travel.railway: Naharlagun Railway Station, approx. 12-15 km from Itanagar.
travel.road: Indira Gandhi Park lies near VIP Road / Sector D, Itanagar; autos and taxis run from Itanagar town centre.

visitor_information.best_time: October to March, the pleasant season for visiting Itanagar's parks.
visitor_information.opening_hours: No temple hours to report (unconfirmed temple); the park itself is a daytime public space (verify).
